subject.title: fix(node): harden reconnect and local inference cancellation

question: Should this combined gateway/node/local-inference lifecycle repair land as one rebased change after validating the exact current-main merge result?
rationale: The protected maintainer label and a single patch spanning transport reconnection, node result publication, CLI deadlines, and shared inference-worker cancellation require an owner to accept the coupled lifecycle behavior.

options.title: Rebase and validate the combined repair
options.body: Refresh the branch on current main and rerun the focused reconnect, cancellation, timeout, and embedding-worker contention coverage against that exact head.

options.title: Split by ownership boundary
options.body: Separate the provider-worker changes from gateway and node-host lifecycle changes if maintainers want independent review and landing risk.

options.title: Defer the combined change
options.body: Pause the PR if the current release cycle cannot absorb coordinated changes to remote-node availability and cancellation behavior.

recommendation.title: Rebase and validate the combined repair
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch on current main and rerun the focused reconnect, cancellation, timeout, and embedding-worker contention coverage against that exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed branch and proof narrative consolidate the affected ownership boundaries, making this the best available routing candidate for a maintainer decision.
